plan: Represent everything as plain JSON-shaped dicts with fractions.Fraction quantities; adapt() builds fresh copies so neither recipe, request, nor catalog is ever mutated, and print_original() just returns authored_text verbatim.
Scale once up front: scale = target_yield / recipe yield, applied to every ingredient (including component and substitution-added ingredients) as exact Fraction arithmetic.
Rank the catalog by (priority, original catalog index) once; _pick(name) scans that ranking so lower priority wins and catalog order breaks ties deterministically.

Resolve each ingredient with a substitution chain: while its name is excluded, pick the best catalog choice, apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation, run wording_changes as global string rewrites over the instruction list, apply equipment add/remove, fold in yield_factor, and recursively resolve additional_ingredients; a per-chain seen-set detects cycles ('substitution cycle involving NAME'), a missing choice yields 'no substitution for NAME', and a replacement that is itself excluded produces a reintroduction warning before the chain continues.

Accumulate reasons and warnings in dedup-append sinks and never stop early, so every independently applicable reason (missing substitutions, cycles, and every unavailable equipment item after substitutions settle) appears in the sorted reasons list; choices records every catalog id considered in order.

Process optional components in a snapshot/rollback scope: if a component's ingredients cannot be resolved and it is optional, restore choices/warnings/instructions/equipment/yield state and emit an 'omitted optional component' warning instead of failing; non-optional component failures merge into the global reasons.

After substitutions, verify final equipment against available_equipment, rebalance quantities if any yield_factor moved the effective yield (with a warning), and assemble the adapted recipe with sorted equipment at exactly the target yield; return possible/recipe/choices/sorted warnings/sorted reasons per the contract.

Embed the executable acceptance contract in __main__: 3→5 scaling, chained substitution with a reintroduced exclusion, a substitution that rewrites a referenced verb and swaps equipment chosen by explicit priority over catalog order plus a tie-break check, four simultaneous impossibility reasons including a cycle, byte-exact print_original after all adaptations, and deep-equality proof of input non-mutation.
mechanisms: non-mutating copy-on-build with authored_text preserved byte-for-byte
exact Fraction yield scaling applied uniformly, including substitution-added ingredients
catalog ranking by (priority, catalog index) for deterministic choice and tie-breaking
per-ingredient substitution chain with seen-set cycle detection
global wording rewrites over plain instruction strings via old/new pairs
equipment as a set with post-substitution availability validation
dedup-append reason/warning sinks that collect all independent failures before reporting
yield_factor rebalancing so the adapted recipe always lands exactly on the target yield
